learning_objective: The learner can describe the post-training workflow consisting of supervised finetuning and preference finetuning used to align a pre-trained foundation model with human preferences.

common_misconceptions.description: Believing post-training adds new knowledge to the model rather than aligning existing capabilities with human preferences.
Assuming post-training consists solely of RLHF, ignoring the supervised finetuning step that precedes preference finetuning.
Thinking post-training makes a model completely safe and foolproof, despite human preference being diverse and impossible to capture in a single formula.
